name: URGH! A MUSIC WAR with The Professors of Urgh!
description: ★ Rating: 8/10 🎭 Artistic Merit. Derek Burbidge’s film is strongest as a rapid, carefully assembled gallery of live performance. The 96 minute cut moves from The Police’s tense, economical “Driven to Tears,” to Wall of Voodoo’s theatrical “Back in Flesh,” Kla…
